actions.description: Run supported full regression test cases across lottery regression (doc 140) and universal regression (script sub-cases 141), then aggregate a single report.
actions.fallback: If full regression fails, run lottery regression and universal regression suites separately and compare their reports.

actions.description: Run the first-stage lottery admin main regression orchestration by chaining stable prize, register-template, roulette-task, activity-draft, and online workflows.
actions.fallback: If orchestration fails, run the child cached actions separately and retain the phaseResults summary for recovery.

actions.description: Create one or more prize records from known prize-management defaults.
actions.fallback: Use bundled Playwright browser operation by default; use optional web-access/CDP only for Chrome login-state reuse or live browser context, then update this cache if the fix is reusable.

actions.description: Copy one prize record by prize ID and verify the copied row.
actions.fallback: Use the prize-management row action workflow if the cached copy script fails.

actions.description: Create roulette activity tasks by participant scope with the validated single-reward defaults.
requiredParams: country or country-first for country scope
actions.fallback: Use the roulette participant-scope browser workflow if the cached script fails, then update the cache with the stable selector change.

actions.description: Create activity user registration templates with selected signup modes, all-platform defaults, and specified agent/user platform restriction branches.
actions.fallback: Use the activity-register-management browser workflow if the cached script fails, then update the cache with stable selector changes.

actions.description: Create a temporary registration template, verify row actions 查看/修改/删除, and delete the temporary record.
actions.fallback: Use the activity-register-management row-action browser workflow and update dialog helpers if Element UI dialog matching changes.

actions.description: Dry-run and delete activity registration templates whose exact recent editor/operator matches the requested operator.
actions.fallback: Run the activity-register-management deletion workflow manually, preserve backend reference-blocking failures, and never delete fuzzy operator matches.

actions.description: For each activity type supported by the admin task list filter, create a minimal cloned task, verify by list/detail, then delete it (headless_api).
actions.fallback: Run task verification by visible browser workflow if API creation fails, then refine the minimal-safe payload per type.

actions.description: For each activity type, pick the most complex template among the first N tasks, clone and create it, verify by list/detail, then delete it (headless_api).
actions.fallback: If a complex clone fails due to uniqueness bindings, switch to another complex template or fall back to visible UI for that type.

actions.description: Create activity guide-flow templates for the verified activity-type/frequency/step combinations.
actions.fallback: Use the activity guide-template browser workflow; NONE/暂无特殊配置 is a known backend-blocked branch unless explicitly retested.

actions.description: Create a temporary activity guide template, verify row actions 查看/修改/复制/删除, and delete the temporary records.
actions.fallback: Use the activity guide-template row-action browser workflow and update Element UI table/dialog helpers if fixed-column or dialog visibility changes.
